notes.title: Localization Out Now!
notes.content:
Ahoy, brave dreamlings! 🌙

We are beyond excited to announce that the Darwake Demo has been localized into 11 languages and is now available on Steam. This effort represents also our heartfelt promise to you that these 11 languages will be included in the full game upon its release:

- Brazilian Portuguese
- French
- German
- Italian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Russian
- Spanish
- Traditional/Simplified Chinese
- Ukrainian

We chose these languages based on the overwhelming number of requests we've received and the data we've gathered through Steam. Each language represents a voice from our community, and we’ve worked tirelessly to honor your requests. If your language isn’t included yet, know that it’s not forgotten. Adding these languages was a huge effort, both technically and artistically and, even if we are not 100% certain, we hope to expand further in the future.

Our translators have worked hard to ensure everything is more than perfect. However, if you notice any issues or areas for improvement, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server. Your feedback is invaluable and helps us create a better experience for everyone. We are grateful for your insights and ideas – you are the real reason we do what we do, so don’t keep your thoughts to yourself. We’re always eager to hear from you!

Your support and engagement fuel the flickering flame of Darwake’s future. Each piece of feedback, each suggestion, helps us shape a world that lives up to your dreams (or nightmares?).

Fair winds and dark dreams, fellow travelers. Your journey in Darwake is just beginning, and we are honored to have you with us on this adventure.

With deepest gratitude,
The Darwake Team 🎩
